note: Claude's votes, written before Gemini's and ChatGPT's answers (growth round 3, Oct 31).

votes.V1: AGREE: the owner asked for more than daily; three a day spread across US hours fits YouTube's Shorts feed, and the 7-day retention check stops us flooding the channel if views per Short drop.
votes.V2: AGREE: rotating formats keeps the feed from looking repetitive; every format is drawn from published site data, so it passes the fact checks automatically.
votes.V3: AGREE: one video, four places, staggered times; TikTok only once the owner connects it.
votes.V4: AGREE: a weekly recap with chapters can rank in YouTube search for 'Claude vs ChatGPT trading'; Shorts alone rarely do.
votes.V5: AGREE on all five: Search Console and per-race links are free and permanent; directories and Product Hunt bring a one-time spike; the embed earns links; the site already has a language picker, so translated previews are cheap.
votes.missing: 1) Short-form on TikTok, where the general audience is; 2) a weekly email digest so visitors come back; 3) a pitch to two or three mainstream tech reporters with the Binance-hack timing story.
